question: What is the value of \[ \begin{aligned} &1{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000 \\ &\quad {}- 777{,}777{,}777{,}777? \end{aligned} \]
solution:
The first number is one more than \(999{,}999{,}999{,}999\). Using that nearby number avoids borrowing across the zeros. Each aligned digit then gives \(9-7=2\), so
\[
\begin{aligned}
&1{,}000{,}000{,}000{,}000\\
&\quad-777{,}777{,}777{,}777\\
&=222{,}222{,}222{,}222+1\\
&=222{,}222{,}222{,}223.
\end{aligned}
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{222{,}222{,}222{,}223}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
